description:
The Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana for Self Employment and Livelihoods in Rural Areas (PMMSYELRASGUJ) aims to provide financial support to small entrepreneurs in rural areas. 

The objective is to promote self-employment and generate sustainable livelihoods in rural regions. 

The scheme offers financial assistance in the form of loans to individuals for starting or expanding small businesses. 

Eligibility is primarily for individuals in rural areas who wish to start or grow a micro-enterprise. 

The application process involves submitting an application form along with necessary documents to the designated financial institution. 

The timeline for loan disbursement varies based on the financial institution's processing time. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development in collaboration with various financial institutions. 

Additional details regarding specific loan amounts and interest rates may vary based on the financial institution's policies.
